name: annotated-membership-tcn-seed0

recipe.model_selection: fixed final epoch; no early stopping or test-driven selection

historical_run.hardware: CPU; TensorFlow GPU devices unavailable in this environment
historical_run.reproduction: The historical commit and environment are pinned as provenance. A run from the current checkout is a reconstruction and is not expected to be bitwise identical.

target.interpretation: Derived annotated nightly-period membership, not clinical per-sample sleep/wake or official event AP

candidate_policy.wake: Between eligible consecutive integer nights, [wakeup_n, onset_n+1)
candidate_policy.conflicts: Exclude all participants in overlaps or night-order inversions, including located incomplete evidence
candidate_policy.unlocatable: Noncanonical IDs, malformed nonmissing coordinates, timestamp-only or contradictory clock evidence invalidate the series
candidate_policy.status: Candidate interpretation only; annotation semantics require separate review

context_policy.target: last source sample in each window
context_policy.grouping: nonoverlapping native contexts; drop incomplete tail; never stitch
context_policy.exclusion: any nonfinite sensor sample or unknown target; reasons counted independently and jointly

preprocessing.timestamp: record-relative seconds of the last source sample in each feature window
preprocessing.target_alignment: last source sample in each feature window
preprocessing.invalid: drop contexts containing any nonfinite sensor sample
preprocessing.tail: drop incomplete windows and model contexts

normalization.fit_scope: all valid feature frames from training subjects, including unknown-target periods and incomplete context tails

preprocessing.sample_clock: Optional signed int64 Unix seconds; strictly increasing at five seconds. Without it, validate local TS cadence.

sampling.training_stream: each eligible native training context appears exactly once per epoch, with no class balancing or replacement; shuffle uses a bounded buffer of 256, seed 0, and reshuffles each epoch
sampling.batch_tail: retain the final partial batch; drop_remainder is false
sampling.validation_order: declared validation subject order, then native context order; no shuffle
sampling.test_order: declared test subject order, then native context order; no shuffle
sampling.unknown_target_handling: exclude the complete context; never stitch neighboring contexts
sampling.test_selection: all eligible test contexts; fixed final epoch

reference.note: These values describe the recorded run and are not acceptance thresholds for future reconstructions.

limitations: Seeded execution is not a bitwise reproducibility guarantee across environments.
The 240-feature context spans 7,230 seconds and uses future features relative to each target; this is offline, noncausal inference.
The target is candidate annotated-period membership, not clinical sleep/wake or official event average precision.
Exposure of a separate historical SD-2 comparator to this cohort is unresolved; this does not qualify the newly trained frozen-split baseline.
Subject identifiers, recordings, prediction arrays, and model binaries remain local experiment evidence.
